tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gos sku zhal 'byed skabs kyi tho chung bzhugs so// swasti/ dpal sa skya pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs chog mang sgrub mchod kyis skor chen mo'i skabs 'ga' re'am/ rab ston gyi skabs su 'phan nag dang gos sku gang zhal 'byed kyang / mchod phreng phyi bskor grub nyer bzo rig pa rnams kyis lha khang chen mo'i blo 'bur la bris sku zhal phye ba'i steng du/ gdugs chen dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis la bkra shis khra ring / sku mdun du mchod pa sna lnga ci 'byor dang / maṇḍal nas bcas dri bzang gi chu rnams bshams/ sa skor ba rnams 'dus nas lha chen bde yongs su mchod phreng rnams gos sku'i g.yas nas bzung mdun la bskor te g.yon ji tsam slebs kyi bar bsgrigs pa'i nang du nged rang dang / mkhan chen sogs kyi lding ba'i rgyab tu dbu mdzad che ba dbus su bzhugs pa'i ban tshang pa rnams g.yas bkyed g.yon bkyed/ de'i rgyab rgyab las gsum dang bde gling dbu byed bsnyen song sogs g.yas bkyed g.yon bkyed phyi gral nang gral ji tsam rigs pa'i rgyab tu lha chen dbu mdzad/ rab 'byams bka' bcu sogs phyag mtshan med gras rnams dang / mchod phreng gi rgyab tu btsun chung rnams 'bungs la/ ban tshang dbu mdzad kyis bskul ba'i sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma shur ma gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam dag chos dbyings nas/ de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol gyi bar/ chos spyod rab gsal gyi dbu bzhin la gdangs bcas/ de nas thams cad kyis phyag phul la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs shlau ka gcig mthun pa'i dge tshogs sogs/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes sogs/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nas/ bshes gnyen kun la phyag 'tshal lo'i bar lam 'bras phyag mchod kyi mjug bzhin bskul mtshams byas la/ gang gi 'phrul dang sogs/ gang sngon sbyin pa sogs/ mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs/ ji snyed su dag sogs/ na bza' dam pa rnams nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi'i bar rol mo sbugs la brjod/

de nas tsog pur 'dug la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang nas/ phyir bsngo'i bar brjod pa'i mthar phyag gcig phul la gral la 'khod/ mchod dpon pa sogs kyis me tog bkyed/ badzra yakṣa sogs mchod pa bsang sbyang sogs kun rig bzhin/ mchod yon phal cher ma gdangs ma/ zhabs bsil kha bskong mi dgos/ tshig mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ ces dang / oṃ gu ru sogs rgyun bzhin rol mo phul grub nas/ oṃ sarba bid nas/ a warta ya ho'i bar/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga'i tshig rnams kyang kun rig dkyil chog sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ 'dod yon gyi skabs/ mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na zhes dang / sna bdun sna lnga'i sngags rnams kyi 'gor yang / oṃ gu ru sogs sbyar/ nged rang sogs kyi maṇḍal la tshom bu bkod/ gzhan rnams kyis phyag rgya bcas la/ maṇḍal so bdun ma gdangs ma/ gang gi mchod rdzas dang / deng nas byang chub shur ma sngags bcas/ sems rtse ma gdangs ma tshar gcig de nas rab ston yin na langs nas brtan bzhugs tshar gsum rab gnas gyi gzhung bzhin la/ tshig mi 'dra ba bye brag tu yang rten 'di rnams la zhes sbyar/ sa mchod yin na/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku sogs/ khyed la mchod cing sogs/ gang ltar na'ang gnyis ka la 'gro la bde skyid ma gdangs ma/ sa mchod yin na 'di nas langs/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sogs/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i skyob pa sogs/ dkon mchog gsum dngos sogs/ dge 'dis bstan 'dzin sogs/ gangs can bod kyi sogs/ gtsug lag rnams ni sogs/ lha yang dus su sogs/ sman rnams mthu dang sogs/ byang chub sems mchog sogs/ bdag la dmigs brten sogs/ skye zhing skye ba sogs/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub sogs/ chos mthun 'byor pa'i sogs/ gtsug gi nor bu sogs/ bsam pa rnam par sogs/ lus kyi las ngan sogs/ kun gyi dge la sogs/

sems can thams cad bde dang sogs/ sems can 'di dag sogs/ dge ba 'di yis sogs/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs/ 'di rnams rab gnas yin na 'dur ma dang / sa mchod yin na bla mchod kyi mjug ltar gdangs thung bya/ bkra shis la'ang rab gnas yin na/ dril gsil gyi gdangs dang / sa mchod yin na bla mchod kyi mjug gi bkra shis kyi gdangs bcas gang ltar na'ang / rgyal mtshan rtse mo༞ sa chen bla ma༞ bstan pa'i bdag po༞ ston pa sangs rgyas༞ mi 'gyur lhun po༞ chos sku nam mkha'༞ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i༞ dpal ldan lha mo༞ bdag gis tshe rabs༞ smra bsam brjod med༞ 'jam dbyangs phyag na༞ dus gsum rgyal ba rgyal sras༞ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang༞ zab cing rgya cher༞ nor gyi dbang phyug༞ lo brgya 'tsho zhing༞ 'bad dang stsol bas༞ dngos brgyud bla ma༞ sbyin pa gtong zhing༞ ston pa 'jig rten༞ 'gro ba'i bla ma༞ bgegs rigs stong phrag༞ rab gnas yin na/ rol chen dang bcas/ nyin mo bde legs༞ sa mchod yin na nyin bde ma gdangs ring / de nas rab gnas dang sa mchod sogs byang du byas pa yin na/ mchod phreng rnams nas bzung gral rim bzhin mthil skor bskor ba'i mthar phyi phebs nas bzhi thog bde yangs sogs gnas gang dang 'brel chags pa der bsdu/ lhor yin na bkra shis grub nas rang rang stabs gang bder gyis/ mthil skor rjes la mdzad skabs mchod phreng thog mar 'thon dus ma byung kyang chog go/ //zhes gos sku zhal 'byed kyi tho chung 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos sbyar/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ gos sku zhal 'byed skabs kyi tho chung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
